notToBeConfusedWith.name: Gin
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Also a neutral spirit at a similar strength, but redistilled or infused with botanicals; vodka is defined by their absence.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, distilled, vodka, 80 proof. Public domain. 80 US proof is 40% alcohol by volume by definition; the record's own measured ethanol content against its measured density works out at 39.8%, the cross-check. Bottles run from 37.5% upwards and a stronger one moves every figure it touches.
